correctness.rationale: Differentiation gives normalized tangent coefficients; 133-point exhaustive modular enumeration finds 90 smooth rational points and 72 attained tangent coefficients; the 18 explicitly listed are actual attained tangents, cover every point with incidence histogram (1:90,2:15,3:25,7:3), and form a dual projective triangle. Full 72 tangents meet every point in at most 11 lines, forbidding any dual full line (12 points). The applicable published Blokhuis 1994 lower bound gives at least 18. All finite checks run on the embedded standalone verifier.
